title: Always ordering GrabFood or foodpanda but want to lose weight: how to choose your menu
intro: You can still order food through apps and lose weight. The key is to choose menus with a clear protein, ask for less oil or gravy, and avoid the 'add a bit more for free delivery' trap.

sections.p: Look for menus with a clear protein source: ayam bakar, ikan bakar, eggs, daging masak kicap or tofu. Protein keeps you full longer. For example, nasi ayam bakar is usually lower in calories than nasi ayam goreng berempah, an estimated difference of 150-250 kcal.

sections.h: Use the 'notes' section in the app
sections.p: Many shops read customer notes. Write 'half rice', 'gravy separate' or 'less oil'. If that's not possible, control it yourself: eat half the rice and keep the rest for tomorrow.

Free delivery with a minimum order often makes us add a sweet drink or dessert. That can add an estimated 200-400 kcal. Better to order together with office mates to reach the minimum, not add more food for yourself.

Try nasi campur with 1 protein and 2 vegetables, chicken soup or beef soup with rice, mee sup, or a grilled chicken set. Western food is fine too, choose grilled and swap fries for salad or vegetables if there's an option.
Many delivery menus are low in vegetables. Keep cucumber, cherry tomatoes or packed salad in the office or home fridge. Eat your vegetables first, then the rice and dishes.

action: List 3 'safe choice' menus from your favourite shops and save them in favourites.
Every time you order, write one request in the notes like 'half rice' or 'gravy separate'.
Choose plain water or teh O ais kosong instead of sweet drinks when there's a set promotion.
Limit late-night orders to 2 times a week first.
myth: Many people think delivery food is all unhealthy. Actually, many people successfully lose weight even when ordering every day, as long as menu choices and portions are controlled.

faq.q: I'm tired after work, I have to order dinner. What's the safest?
faq.a: Choose soup with a little rice, grilled fish or chicken, or telur dadar with vegetables. Avoid menus with the words 'fried', 'crispy' or 'cheese' every night.
Yes, once in a while. Choose a regular burger or skinless chicken, small size, and a drink without sugar. It can still fit into your daily calories.

faq.q: How do I know the calories of menus in the app?
faq.a: Most shops don't show calories. Use estimates: 1 cup of white rice is about 200 kcal, one medium piece of fried chicken is about 250-300 kcal. It doesn't need to be exact, consistency is more important.
